lines.text: Sheesh, you finished that so fast!

data.define: A reaction to something impressive or surprising.

example.text: Sheesh, you finished that so fast!

publish.title: What does "sheesh" mean?
publish.value: Sheesh = Wow, that's impressive. Example: "Sheesh, you finished that so fast!" (very casual English, US).
